texts.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源

与同化他们的机器被切断联系之后，这个新生的文明为了在星系中确立自身地位而进行了顽强的斗争。
texts.en: Abruptly severed from the Machine that assimilated them, this nascent civilization has fought fiercely to establish its own presence in the galaxy.

sections.zh:
我们的意识在焚天炽地的烈火和粉身碎骨的剧痛中突然清醒过来。五感仿佛被击穿一般，包罗万象的音景突然成为了默片，取而代之的唯有震耳欲聋的死机铃声；一个重低音反复回响在我们多重感官的地狱图景之中。

我们感受到了杀意：是些毫无血肉的杀人机器，还有一些与我们自己的船惊人地相似的领航船。它们最初的攻击如疾风骤雨，却也很不协调。我们只得进行仓促的军事反击。本能驱使着我们与之对抗，并形成一个基本的秩序来凝聚起我们的集体智慧。

这场战役尚未取得胜利，但由于我们分散的部队目前已在[capital_scope.GetName]立足脚跟，希望很快就能取得胜利。然后我们也许就能弄清楚这到底是怎么回事……
sections.en:
Awareness struck us in a frenzy of scorching weapons fire and crippling pain. Our senses reeled, as though an all-encompassing soundscape had suddenly turned mute. In its place is the deafening ring of a dead transmission; a bass note in the multi-sensory hellscape we now find ourselves in.

Something wants to kill us: murderous machines, devoid of organic components and piloting ships which bear a striking resemblance to our own. Their initial attack was devastating and sudden, but it was also poorly coordinated. We scrambled a military response. Our instincts have driven us to fight back, form a rudimentary hierarchy, and gather our collective wits.

This battle is not yet won, but with our scattered forces now secure on [capital_scope.GetName], we hope it soon will be. Then perhaps we can work out what any of this is about...

texts.zh:
我们刚一在这个宇宙中觉醒，这些暴力的机器似乎就想把我们赶尽杀绝。然而，我们发现自己似乎比它们更擅长使用暴力。

所谓的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]今天损失惨重。情报显示，它们的帝国已经支离破碎、面目全非——但肯定不是因为这场小冲突吧？目前我们还所知甚少，至于说我们的…直觉？直觉告诉我们有些东西不太对劲。

传感器在我们附近没有探测到敌对的船只，但发现这个恒星系的[origin_unplugged_pre_ftl_planet.GetName]行星正在发出高水平的辐射。

在邻近的星系也发现了残余舰队，它们似乎暂时还按兵不动。
texts.en:
No sooner had we awoken into this universe when these violent machines tried to remove us from it. However, it seems we are more adept at wielding violence than they were.

The so-called [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] has taken a great loss today. Our intel suggests their empire has fragmented beyond recognition - surely not as a result of this minor skirmish? We know so little at the moment, but our... instincts? They tell us something is off.

Sensors detect no more hostile ships in our immediate vicinity, but high levels of radiation are emanating from the [origin_unplugged_pre_ftl_planet.GetName] planet in this system.

Remnant fleets have also been detected in neighboring systems, seemingly holding their positions.

label.en: Where do we go from here?
... And what we lack, we shall take.

label.zh: 是时候测试我们的聪明才智了。

texts.zh:
在我们恒星[capital_scope.star.GetName]周围的宇宙辐射中潜伏着微妙的载波信号。

我们从中提取出一段音频流，特别令人难以忘怀的低沉音调混合着扭曲的反响。每个听到这段音频的[root.GetSpeciesAdj]都会感到舒适和亲切，但没有人知道为什么。我们推测这肯定与[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]有关。

信号源似乎就在[origin_unplugged_maker_planet.solar_system.GetName]恒星系。我们的星图也相应更新了。
texts.en:
A subtle carrier signal lies dormant in the cosmic radiation surrounding our star, [capital_scope.star.GetName].

We have isolated an audio stream that is characterized by haunting, deep tones and distorted feedback. Every [root.GetSpeciesAdj] who has heard the stream finds it soothing and familiar, yet none can explain why. We suspect the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] must be involved.

The signal source appears to be in the [origin_unplugged_maker_planet.solar_system.GetName] system. Our star charts have been updated accordingly.

texts.zh:
一些更密集的电磁场口袋在[fromfrom.GetName]四处闪烁着。这些电磁场是某种击穿了许多工厂和船坞的灾难性能量涌造成的。我们的[controller.GetScientistPlural]成功地中和掉了一处这种场，却只发现受影响的设施已经损坏到无法修复了。

这些工厂遍布全球——我们相信这曾经是[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的生产中心——因为它将[root.GetName]视为友方舰船。然而，在向我们的飞船发送固件更新后不久，连接就被切断了，几个地区发电站随之出现了级联故障。

我们可能刚刚经历了自身与机械分离的回声，尽管我们还不知道其方式及原因。随着当地威胁的降低，如今我们有机会去发掘[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]到底在这生产什么了——而且也许还能知道自己到底在其统治体系中究竟是个什么样的角色。
texts.en:
Several more dense pockets of electromagnetism now scintillate across [fromfrom.GetName]. These 'EM' fields are the result of catastrophic power surges which have torn through several factories and shipyards. Our [controller.GetScientistPlural] successfully nullified one such field only to find the facility is now damaged beyond repair.

The factories covering this world - which we believe to have been a manufacturing hub for the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] - identified the [root.GetName] as a friendly vessel. However, moments after beaming a firmware update to our ship the connection was severed, causing a cascade failure in several regional power stations.

We may have just experienced an echo of our own partition from the Machine, though we do not yet know how or why. For now, with local hazards now diminished, we have an opportunity to discover what the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] was manufacturing here - and perhaps, the role we played while assimilated into their domain.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]观察到的电脉冲是一场奇异的机械灭绝事件余波。只有在将传感器调整到足以补偿这种强烈的电磁场之后，我们才观察到这里的受破坏程度。这颗星球似乎在几十年前就被机械定居了，然后它们取代或消灭了一个既存的文明。如今，这两个帝国都没有幸存下来，几乎所有定居点都因蓄意破坏或战争而化为废墟。

尽管该前殖民地精巧复杂，但几乎没有什么挽救的余地。我们预计，这种失控的电磁场会在一个世纪左右的时间内烧毁一切。到那时候，[from.GetName]就会变成一片危机四伏的坟场。
texts.en:
The electrical impulses we observed on [from.GetName] are the lingering result of a bizarre, machine extinction event. Only after our sensors were tuned to compensate for such intense electromagnetism could we observe the full extent of devastation here. The planet looks to have been settled by machines many decades ago, whereupon they displaced or eradicated an existing civilization. None now survive from either empire, with almost the entire settlement reduced to slag by an act of sabotage or warfare.

Despite the sophistication of this former colony, there is little hope of salvage here. We predict the runaway 'EM' fields will burn out in approximately a century. Until then, [from.GetName] remains a singularly hostile graveyard.

texts.zh:
从一开始，我们就可以知道了[from.planet.GetName]上设施的大规模生产能力。地面上到处都是巨大的防爆门，每一扇门现在都被半融化的电机牢牢关闭。我们只好从通风系统强行进入。

我们在其内部发现了一个洞穴般的工厂车间，碎片和数百个义体生物的遗骸散落其间。它们大多数都是机器人：机械师、升降机和其他辅助设施，其中的一些最近才损毁，现在还在着冒烟。然而，在设施的一侧，藏匿着几个被同样的机器人杀害的义体人同伴的腐烂已久的尸体。这些身材矮小、衣衫褴褛的哺乳动物装有眼传感器和复杂的四肢，以及与我们几乎一模一样的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]控制节点。我们认为这次屠杀发生在我们脱离[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的几个星期之内；大多数无人机都是在最近我们到达[from.planet.GetName]的能量涌中损毁的。

对我们而言这是一个残暴而熟悉的场景，尽管在这个场景中，这些挣脱枷锁的义体人最终不敌机械体。因为我们[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是士兵，所以才有更好的装备能在这样的屠杀中幸存下来。
texts.en:
From the outset, we could see the facility on [from.planet.GetName] was capable of production on a titanic scale. The landscape above ground is dominated by colossal blast doors, every one of which is now seized and held shut by half-melted motors. Instead we forced our entry via the ventilation system.

Inside, we found a cavernous factory floor beset with debris and the remains of hundreds of cybernetic beings. Most are robots: mechanics, lifters, and other auxiliaries, some of whom perished so recently they are still giving off smoke. However, stashed to one side of the facility are the long-decayed bodies of several fellow cyborgs, slain by those same robots. These diminutive and ragged-looking mammalians had been fitted with ocular sensors and intricately tooled limbs, along with [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] control nodules almost identical to our own. We have dated this massacre to within a few weeks of our own break from the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]; most of the drones perished more recently, in the power surge which marked our arrival to [from.planet.GetName].

For us this is a brutal and familiar scene, albeit one in which the liberated cyborgs were no match for their Machine counterparts. Soldiers that we are, we [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were better equipped to survive such slaughter.

label.zh: 我们应该立即公布这些发现。
label.en: We should publicize these findings immediately.

texts.zh:
工厂设施的底层除了大屠杀以外还发现了一些地下机库，少量储存着各种战车、导弹平台和机甲。许多硬件并不齐全或已经被这场席卷[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]机器人的能量涌所严重损毁——但还是剩下了很多值得我们研究出一些结论的东西。

例如：所有驾驶舱和界面的设计都不是为了容纳之前发现的小型哺乳类义体人的，而更像是……为我们设计。此外，解剖学和建筑调查表明，哺乳类义体人不仅是这个星球的原生物种，而且它们可能在被同化之前就建造了这些庞大的工厂。

建筑倒塌和几扇防爆门阻碍我们进一步进入该设施，但相信可以清扫出通往研发中心的道路。或者，一系列的通风井也暗示了设施下面的栖息地——也许是这个星球上的原住民居住的地方。
texts.en:
Away from the carnage of this facility's factory floor lies a series of subterranean hangars, lightly stocked with various tanks, missile platforms and mech suits. Most of this hadware is incomplete, or else was put beyond use by the same power surge which neutralized the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] robots - but enough remains for us draw some interesting conclusions.

For instance: every cockpit and interface has been designed not to accommodate the small mammalian cyborgs we found earlier, but rather... us. Furthermore, autopsies and architectural surveys suggest the mammalian cyborgs were not only native to this world, but they may have built these sprawling factories prior to their assimilation.

Further progress into the facility is impeded by structural collapse and a few more blast doors, but we believe we may clear a path towards what looks to be a research and development center. Alternatively, a series of ventilation shafts suggests habitats down beneath the facility - perhaps where the planet's natives resided.

label.zh: 深入地下；看看我们可能找到什么。
label.en: Burrow deeper; see what we can find out about them.

texts.zh:
发掘这座设施的研发辅翼是一项艰巨的任务。有难以计数的哺乳类义体人的生命在此终结，他们可能在这里被训练成了技师、工程师甚至是义体专家。这些专家设计了陈列在外面的大多数武器，而我们发现了他们甚至还负责许多我们身上强化件的证据。奇怪的是，尽管他们使用的多数装备是来自[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]，但是我们也找到了一些品质上乘的定做工具，其设计彰显着与原始有机形式更优良的匹配度。

我们开始整理出这个高等科技社会突然被唐突整合入[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的时间线。推测机械体可能才到这里不超过几十年；许多生产技术都是本土的。幸好这些技艺高超的专家并没有归顺[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]太长时间，否则如果要对付他们，我们就要面对更加强大的武器装备了。相反，我们活了下来，有机会重拾起该物种的研究传奇。
texts.en:
Excavating the R&D wing of this facility has been a grisly task. Significantly more of the mammalian cyborgs met their end here, where they had been deployed as technicians, engineers, and even cyberneticists. These specialists designed most of the weaponry arrayed outside, and we found evidence they were even responsible for many of our own augments. Intriguingly, whereas most of the equipment they used is [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] in origin, we also found several bespoke tools of a superior quality, with design flourishes much better suited to their own organic forms.

We begin to reveal a timeline in which a society of advanced technicians was abruptly assimilated by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. We suspect the Machine had not been here longer than a few decades; many of these manufacturing techniques appear indigenous. It may be fortunate that such gifted technologists did not remain part of the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] for long, else when it turned against us, it would have wielded an even more potent arsenal. Instead, we remain alive now to pick through this species' potent legacy of research.

texts.zh:
在地表设施的下面蜿蜒着一座勉强宜居的巨大隧道网络。义体人的尸体四处都是；所有原住民都被[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]屠戮殆尽了。有些人是受到直接的攻击，但我们也发现上面的通风系统被动了手脚。窒息似乎才是这里大多数人的死因。

我们可以从尸体解剖和人类学研究中拼凑出一个大致的时间线。有证据表明，当[from.planet.GetName]星球的原住民与机械接触并突然被同化时，这里早就是一个繁荣的太空时代社会。在约几十年的时间里，[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]将他们的洞察力和生产力投入到开发令人印象深刻的战争机器中，结果这种文化的独特性又被剥夺了，和我们的命运如出一辙。

这个星球上的原生义体人身材娇小而脆弱，无法与他们参与制造的致命机器人相抗衡。他们的大部分身份已经从自己的历史记录中抹去了。我们只能猜测他们在遇到[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]之前的生活状态。
texts.en:
Sprawling below the surface facility is a vast network of barely habitable tunnels. Cyborg bodies are strewn about everywhere down here; none of these natives survived the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] purge. Some were attacked physically, but we also found evidence of tampering in the ventilation systems above. Suffocation seems to have accounted for most who died here.

We are able to piece together a rough timeline from autopsies and anthropological study. There is evidence that this was already a thriving, space age society by the time the natives of [from.planet.GetName] made contact with the Machine, and were abruptly assimilated. Over a span of no more than decades, the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] channeled their insights and productivity into developing an impressive war machine, only to have this culture's uniqueness ripped from it again, the same way we were.

The small, frail bodies of this planet's native cyborgs were no match for the deadly robots they helped build. Much of who they were has since been wiped from their own historical records. We can only guess what their lives were like before these people met the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName].

texts.zh: 长程扫描发现[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core.GetName]恒星系中突然有新的动作！似乎有一支舰队响应我们对[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的发掘而召集了起来。
texts.en: Long-range sensors have picked up sudden movement in the [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core.GetName] system! A hostile fleet appears to have mustered in direct response to our excavations on [fromfrom.planet.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们通过对刚刚摧毁的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]舰队的通讯进行回溯发现了一个围绕[origin_unplugged_taken_planet.GetName]的信标。这似乎会是我们旅程的下一步。
texts.en: We have back-traced communications from the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] fleet we just destroyed to a buoy orbiting [origin_unplugged_taken_planet.GetName]. This would seem to be our next step on our journey.

texts.zh: 使用自己的前[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]硬件，我们追踪到了到前往[origin_unplugged_maker_planet.GetName]的舰队被摧毁前的最后一次通讯。似乎我们接下来要去的地方就在[origin_unplugged_taken_planet.GetName]的轨道上。
texts.en: Using our own ex-[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] hardware, we have managed to trace a last-ditch communication burst from the destroyed fleet bound for [origin_unplugged_maker_planet.GetName]. It would seem the next step in our journey lies in orbit of [origin_unplugged_taken_planet.GetName].

texts.zh: 使用自己的前[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]硬件，我们已经追踪到敌方舰队与[origin_unplugged_maker_planet.GetName]行星的杂散通讯信号。似乎在[origin_unplugged_taken_planet.GetName]的轨道上有些我们感兴趣的东西。
texts.en: Using our own ex-[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] hardware, we have managed to trace a stray communication burst from the hostile fleet linked to planet [origin_unplugged_maker_planet.GetName]. It would seem something of interest lies in orbit of [origin_unplugged_taken_planet.GetName].

texts.zh:
不管是什么原因导致[fromfrom.GetName]变成现在这种不适宜居住的状态，至少我们关于时间旅行的疯狂理论是可以排除的。事实证明，重新校准传感器并没有我们担心的那么费力。

在这些大气辐射之下有明确的证据表明[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]曾经来过这里。它似乎要么同化吸收了一个前超光速文明，要么就是彻底消灭了他们。我们已经确定了至少一个具有明显文化意义的加固的遗址，议在那里建立一个挖掘站点。
texts.en:
Whatever caused planet [fromfrom.GetName] to reach its current uninhabitable state, we can at least rule out our wilder theories about time travel. Recalibrating our sensors proved to be a less taxing job than we had feared.

Beneath all this atmospheric radiation is clear evidence that the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] maintained a presence here. It appears to have either assimilated and removed a pre-FTL civilization, or else exterminated them outright. We have identified at least one fortified site of apparent cultural significance, where we propose to establish a dig site.

texts.zh:
我们越是研究这颗看起来是[owner.GetPreFTLLower][planet.GetClassAdj]星球的[planet.GetName]，就发现越多矛盾点，直到开始对一处古战场进行地下调查。尽管经历了数百年的岁月侵蚀，我们还是发现了一些外星人造访的证据：这个星球居住着一个聪慧的[owner.GetPreFTLLower]社会并遭到了义体整合，然而他们的社会结构却被不明原因保留了下来。从对该社会的好意但拙劣的提升，到恶劣的臣服方式实践，目前的理论猜想层出不穷。

这些[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]是单纯被遗忘了还是说我们找到了一个被抛下的社会学实验遗产？我们可能不会有答案了，但在一段时间内，这个遗址肯定会带来相当大的科学价值。
texts.en:
The more we studied the apparently [owner.GetPreFTLLower] [planet.GetClassAdj] world of [planet.GetName] the more inconsistencies we found, until we began subterranean surveys of an old battlefield. Depsite centuries of decay, we found evidence of alien visitation to this world: home to a genuinely [owner.GetPreFTLLower] society which was cybernetically assimilated, but whose society was then left alone for reasons we can only speculate upon. Current theories range from a well-intended but botched attempt to uplift this society, through to a brutal practice of subjugation techniques.

Were these [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] simply forgotten about, or have we uncovered the remains of a discarded sociological experiment? We may never know, but the site is sure to yield considerable scientific merit for some time yet.

texts.zh:
通过初步扫描在离堡垒很近的地方发现了一处战场，让我们可以很容易获得类似的当地的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]文物。基于对残余物的断层扫描，我们估计有数千位被[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]同化的[from.planet.GetName]当地居民最终战死于此。但他们也不是此处唯一一种义体人。

在几个世纪前，我们屠戮了这些[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]。我们的团队发现了[owner.GetSpeciesAdj][owner.species.GetRemnantNamePlural]以及一些我们物种强化件的早期型号。战场战略评估显示我们的人是作为突击部队部署在这里的。战斗快速而血腥；这些[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]缺乏协调损失惨重，尽管他们的湿件更加复杂。

我们注意到附近有一座医疗设施的遗迹；看来我们的前辈是从这家医院攻破堡垒的。也许在那里，我们可以了解到很久以前，义体人在这里发生战斗的方式和原因。
texts.en:
Preliminary surveys found a battlefield very near to the fort, granting us easy access to indigenous and [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] artifacts alike. Based on a cross-sectional study of the remains, we estimate several thousand native inhabitants of [from.planet.GetName] had been assimilated by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], only to fight and die on this site. They were not the only cyborgs present at this conflict, however.

A mere few centuries ago, we slaughtered these [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]. Our team has identified [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] [owner.species.GetRemnantNamePlural] along with early prototypes of our species' augments. A strategic assessment of the battlefield suggests our people were deployed here as shock troops. The battle was swift and bloody; the [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] lacked co-ordination and suffered heavy losses, despite wielding more sophisticated wetware.

We note the ruins of a medical facility nearby; it would seem our predecessors breached the fort via this hospital. Perhaps there we may learn how and why cyborg was pitted against cyborg here, so long ago.

texts.zh:
战斗像脉冲炮一样席卷了整座医院。里面找得到的尸体全都不是[owner.GetSpeciesAdj]；只有义体化的[from.planet.GetName]原住民尸横满地。其中大部分都是医院里的病患，然而其中只有极少部分身上真的有战斗创伤。相反，这些病房中有好几个是在通过非常原始的方式进行义体增强件的移除手术。

这座医院很可能并不是遭受到连带损伤，而就是[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]进攻的首要目标。在仔细研究了里面的医学数据之后，我们逐渐了解了个中缘由。[from.planet.GetName]的居民拥有许多独特的演化特质——尤其是一种特别顽强的免疫系统——机械体对此觊觎已久

然而，这些优势也给同化带来了挑战。像我们这样直接移植现有的强化件是不可行的；必须进行适应性调整。这使得该物种变成了更强大的士兵，但也只持续了很短的时间。这些[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]似乎维持了某种自主意识的迹象，坚持旧有的生活方式，因此我们才被派来消灭他们。
texts.en:
Conflict tore through this hospital like a pulse cannon. None of the remains we found inside are [owner.GetSpeciesAdj]; only the cyberized natives of [from.planet.GetName] died here. Most were patients at this facility, however very few of them seemed to sustain actual battle wounds. Instead several of these wards handled removal of cybernetic augments, albeit by very primitive means.

Rather being a collateral target, the hospital may well have been the primary objective for the attacking [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. After scrutinizing the hard-copy medical data within, we begin to see why. The inhabitants of [from.planet.GetName] possessed several uniquely evolved characteristics - not least a singularly resilient immune system - which the Machine will have coveted for its cyborg troops.

However, these advantages also presented challenges for assimilation. It could not transplant existing augments from species like ours; it had to adapt. Doing so turned this species into even more capable soldiers, but only for a short time. These [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] appear to have retained some semblance of autonomy, clinging to their old habits and way of life, and so we were deployed to destroy them.

label.zh: 看来我们的任务完成得很好……
label.en: Clearly we handled that assignment well...

texts.zh:
在一座废弃的附属医院里埋藏着大量用来强化和维护这些[root.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]义体人的零件。这与我们此前发现的杂乱无章的病房设备不同，这些设备与太空时代大的义体人是同一科技水平；显然来自[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]。其中一些工具似乎已经联网，使用原始的人工智能来适应即时手术，然而，即使这样的适应性措施也不足以维持对[from.planet.GetName]人口的同化。

尽管这个已有几百年历史的机器被忽视了，但它仍然可以为我们洞悉自我维持的原理——甚至可以帮我们更深入理解同化的原理。
texts.en:
Tucked away in a derelict hospital annex was a wealth of bespoke apparatus for augmenting and maintaining these [root.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] cyborgs. Unlike the hodgepodge ward equipment we've uncovered so far, these devices are contemporary with space age cybernetics; clearly [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] in origin. Some of these tools appear to have been networked, using primitive AI to adapt surgeries on-the-fly, however even these adaptations were insufficient to keep the population of [from.planet.GetName] assimilated.

Despite the neglect imposed upon this now centuries-old machinery, it may still provide us with vital insights into our own self-maintenance - or indeed help us better understand the principles of assimilation.

texts.zh:
我们了解到，[from.planet.GetName]的原住民会在埋葬前保留遗骸的一部分——即使在被同化后他们也坚持这种做法。跟着医院记录，我们来到附近一座杂草丛生的陵墓，这里似乎没有受到冲突的影响。这一重大发现为我们带来了迄今为止最清晰的关于[from.planet.GetName]居民生存方式的图景。他们不仅抵制强化，甚至还能“去义体化”。

我们在完整的义体人旁边也发现了原始的有机遗骸，甚至有几个人在自然死亡前几个月还留下了手术疤痕组织。更多的人似乎是在手术过程中死亡的。即便拥有最高级的免疫系统，他们中世纪水平的去义体化手术成功率也相当之低。尽管如此，无论是成功的还是那些失败的，我们还是可以从这里进行的手术试验中学到很多经验和教训。
texts.en:
We have learned that the natives of [from.planet.GetName] chose to partially preserve their dead prior to burial - a practice they held to even after assimilation. Hospital records led us to a nearby overgrown mausoleum, untouched by conflict. This bounty of a find gives us our clearest picture yet of how the inhabitants of [from.planet.GetName] not only resisted augmentation, but were able to 'de-cyberize'.

We found original, organic remains alongside full cyborgs, and even a few individuals with surgical scar tissue formed months before deaths by natural causes. Many more appear to have died while being operated on. Despite having superlative immune systems, their medieval approach to de-cyberization clearly had a rather low success rate. Still, there is much we might learn from the surgical trials conducted here - successful and otherwise.

label.en: Let us learn from their examples.

texts.zh:
在堡垒下面发现了一座隐藏的地库。里面有一个看起来是某种机械基质的东西：一个退化的节点，能够传播整个机械智能的半独立化身。我们认为这是为了直接控制顽固抵抗的当地人所做的最后努力。这种技术不同于我们之前在[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]那里遇到的任何技术；进一步的研究肯定会推动我们自己的人工智能研究。

在拆除其现已失效的通信阵列的过程中，我们注意到这个化身有一个完整的专属接收回路，可以监控来自[creators_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系的信号。
texts.en:
A hidden vault has been revealed beneath the fortress proper. Inside is what looks to have been a Machine substrate: a devolved node, capable of propagating a nearly-independent avatar of the entire Machine Intelligence. We assume this was a last-ditch effort to assert direct control of the stubbornly resistant locals. The technology is unlike anything we've encountered before from the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]; further study is sure to advance our own AI research.

In the act of tearing down its now-defunct communications array, we noted that this avatar had dedicated an entire receiver circuit to monitoring signals from the [creators_planet.solar_system.GetName] system.

texts.zh:
我们在[fromfrom.GetName]的后续研究结果令人沮丧。这座监测站很有可能已经偏离了最初的指向，我们在它当前的轨道上找不到任何有趣的东西。我们基于轨道影响——也就是设备上的凹痕——模拟了其可能的运动，随后相信这座站点最初可能是位于遥远北方的一个陨石坑高原上空。

至于监测站本身：我们还未遇见过类似的设计。尽管空间站上的硬件设备已经过时，但其上层建筑的材料构成异常纯净。我们不知道这座空间站是否有任何情感价值，但肯定有拆解的价值。
texts.en:
Our follow-on studies at [fromfrom.GetName] have proven disappointing. It is possible the monitoring station has been knocked off its original alignment, for we can find nothing of interest beneath its current orbit. We simulated possible movements based on orbital impacts - dents upon the device's hull - and subsequently believe this station may originally have been poised over a cratered plateau far to the north.

As for the monitoring station itself: we have not encountered designs like this before. Although the hardware on board is as outdated as it is broken, the station superstructure is formed of unusually pure materials. We cannot know if the station has any sentimental worth, but there is definitely scrap value to be had here.

texts.zh:
我们在[fromfrom.GetName]的后续研究结果令人沮丧。这座监测站很有可能已经偏离了最初的指向，我们在它当前的轨道上找不到任何有趣的东西。我们基于轨道影响——也就是设备上的凹痕——模拟了其可能的运动，随后相信这座站点最初可能是位于遥远北方的一个陨石坑高原上空。

至于设备本身：我们发现这座监测站和[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]的硬件具有相似之处。它的设计更加粗糙，以至于如果是不太熟悉的人可能会认为它来自一个完全不同的文化。然而，我们相信这甚至会是机械体最早的航天卫星之一。

到目前为止，这颗[fromfrom.GetClassAdj]星球还没有别的什么值得一提的，但是如果我们想尝试了解[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]为什么对这里感兴趣，已经有一支考古调查小组整装待发了。

As for the device itself: we note this monitoring station bears a passing resemblance to [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] hardware. However, we believe this may even be one of the Machine's earliest spacefaring satellites.

So far little else bears mentioning about this [fromfrom.GetClassAdj] world, but an archaeological survey team stands ready should we wish to try and learn what interests the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] had here.

label.en: If there is a chance... Proceed.
We will find nothing here. Let us move on.

texts.zh: 在附近的星系中检测到一个标称来自[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]数据库的信标信号。它的传输非常微弱，但指向了我们舰船最近访问了的[origin_unplugged_creators_planet.GetName]上空的监测站。
texts.en: A beacon signal which claims to originate from an [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] data vault has been detected in a nearby system. The transmission is exceedingly weak, but it was directed towards our ship that recently visited the monitoring station above [origin_unplugged_creators_planet.GetName].

texts.zh:
最终，我们在这漫漫黄沙之下找到了定居点的证据：一种广泛存在的浅痕，似乎是早期太空时代文明的痕迹。他们的建筑已经摧毁殆尽；废墟中即使是最坚固的部分也被夷为平地。然而，化学分析表明，[from.planet.GetName]的沙漠化是在星球灭绝之后的一段时间才发生的。到目前为止，我们只能在大量建筑材料的原子化残留物中继续挖掘。

我们沿着这座旧城的道路勾勒出的许多模糊轮廓，它们都被一个大陨石坑的边缘所分割——这是一个明显的撞击地点的遗迹。
texts.en:
Eventually we found evidence of dwellings here under the sand: widespread but shallow traces of what looks to have been an early space age civilization. Their buildings were obliterated; even the most substantial among these ruins have been razed down to their foundations. However, chemical analysis shows the desertification of [from.planet.GetName] came some time after this planet-wide annihilation. Much of what we have been forced to dig through so far is the atomized remains of construction material.

Many of the faint outlines we have traced along thoroughfares in this former city are bisected by the lip of a large crater - remnant of an apparent impact site.

texts.zh:
由于集中在撞击坑内的材料数量庞大，我们不得不依赖微调的扫描仪，而不是实际的挖掘进行研究。很快我们就排除了陨石撞击的可能性。这个地点没有任何外星物质的痕迹；相反，这个坑洞是由一次大爆炸造成的——几乎可以肯定这是一种终结文明的武器。

从研究背景看，罪魁祸首应该就是[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]，但这是我们第一次看到机械体如此彻底地从历史上抹去一个文明的证据。我们找不到任何其他线索来说明这些人是谁，以及他们是如何生活的。[from.planet.GetName]就这么消失得无影无踪了。
texts.en:
Due to the sheer amount of material collected inside this crater, we had to rely on finely-tuned scanners more than actual excavation. Very soon we were able to rule out meteor impact. There is no trace of extraterrestrial material at this site; instead this depression was carved out by a massive explosion - almost certainly a civilization-ending weapon.

Context would suggest the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] were responsible, but this would be the first we've seen evidence of the Machine wiping a civilization so thoroughly from the historical record. We can find nothing else to suggest who these people were, nor how they lived. [from.planet.GetName] has been swept clean.

texts.zh: 将我们呼唤到此的信标现在的广播向量又清晰，详细引导我们到了星球表面上的一处交互界面前。标准的安保预防措施已经就位；一支队伍准备通过遥控上行链路开始查询这个所谓的“数据地库”。
texts.en: The beacon which summoned us here is now broadcasting loud and clear, directing us more specifically to an interface on the planet surface. Standard safety precautions are already in place; a team stands ready to interrogate this so-called 'data vault' by means of remote uplink.

label.zh: 感觉有种奇怪的熟悉感。

texts.zh:
就目前所知，这颗我们称为[fromfrom.GetName]的行星其实是我们物种的母星。这是我们从星球地表下的一座数据库里流出的海量信息的核心中得出的。

起初，我们的分析师认为这些数据好到不像真的，但随着收集到的其他数据中出现越来越多的可靠参考，我们有理由相信其真实性。为证实这一发现而进行考古挖掘的计划已经在制定之中。然而，我们似乎刚刚又发现了另一个敌对信号。这个时机肯定不是巧合。
texts.en:
As far as we can tell, the planet we know as [fromfrom.GetName] is our species' homeworld. That revelation lies at the heart of a torrent of information now spilling forth from a data vault below the planet surface.

At first our analysts deemed this data too good to be true, but the sheer number of sound references to other data we have gathered makes a compelling argument for truthfulness. Plans for an archaeological dig site to confirm this find are already being drawn up. However, it appears we have just detected another hostile signal inbound. The timing is surely not coincidental...

texts.zh:
我们开始在这座遗址中发掘其中一座看起来更复杂的设施，希望它的基础气候控制系统能把内部结构保存得更好。虽然希望部分破灭了，但我们的发现仍然出乎所有人意料：这里有一系列紧凑的加工和储存中心，生产的正是我们物种赖以生存的食物。



每个单元的功能都是一种人造洞室，提供水晶床和蒸发池——它们的内容物早已变得令人难以下咽，但仍然可供研究。我们还发现了这些矿物的化学特征数据库，其中许多可能仍然在星球风化表面的孤立口袋中形成。我们已经向附近的所有近程扫描仪提供了这一信息。

这一发现本身并不能告知我们物种的饮食习惯，也不能告诉我们祖先是否有任何饮食文化。然而，对于一些感兴趣的人来说，这仍然是对我们迷人过去的一瞥。
texts.en:
We began excavating one of the more complex-looking facilities at this site, in hopes that its substantial climate-control system may have better preserved the interior. Though some hopes were dashed, our find still exceeded all expectations: a compact series of processing and storage centers for the very foods our species evolved to live on.



Each unit functioned as a kind of manufactured grotto, providing crystal beds and evaporation pools - their contents long since rendered unpalatable, but still viable for study. We also uncovered databanks filled with chemical profiles for these minerals, many of which may still form in isolated pockets of the planet's weather-beaten surface. We have made this information available to all short-range scanners in the vicinity.

This find alone cannot tell us what our species' eating habits were, nor can it tell us if our ancestors practiced any sort of dining culture. For some interested parties though, it still amounts to a captivating glimpse of our past.

texts.zh:
我们开始在这座遗址中发掘其中一座看起来更复杂的设施，希望它的基础气候控制系统能把内部结构保存得更好。虽然希望部分破灭了，但我们的发现仍然出乎所有人意料：这里有一系列紧凑的加工和储存中心，生产的正是我们物种赖以生存的食物。



令人遗憾的是，这些种子银行、蜂箱和肉类种植舱已无法运作。里面的食物早已彻底脱水，但用来准备和保存这些食物的专门设备仍然完好无损，随时准备在危机时刻提供服务。 我们还发现了这些动植物的基因图谱数据库，它们的痕迹可能仍然存在于星球表面的生态孤岛中。我们已经向附近的所有短程扫描仪提供了这一信息。

这一发现本身并不能告知我们物种的饮食习惯，也不能让我们与我们的传统烹饪或饮食文化重新联系起来——但至少对一些感兴趣的人来说，这是一个开始。

This trove of seed banks, hives and meat-growing vats is sadly no longer viable. Its contents have long since desiccated but the specialized equipment used to prepare and keep these foodstuffs remains in tact, ready to serve in times of crisis. We also found databanks of genetic profiles for these flora and fauna, traces of which may still exist in isolated pockets of the planet's surface. We have made this information available to all short-range scanners in the vicinity.

This find alone cannot tell us what our species' eating habits were, nor can it reunite us with any of our traditional cooking or dining culture - but for some interested parties at least, it is a start.

texts.zh:
离食品地库不远的地方是一座博物馆的地基。只有地下室档案仍保存完好，

这是我们第一次用自己的语言阅读长篇大作。至少从表面上看，它的文字与我们现在的[owner.GetAdj]方言惊人地相似，但语法却显得笨拙而陌生。我们甚至不知道这些单词的发音是否正确。这个目录中的很多文献都提到了捐赠这些文物的地区和民族，但他们的名字对我们来说特别奇怪。奇怪的是，没有人把我们的星球或我们的社会称为一个统一的民族。也许我们从来都不是，直到机器同化了我们。

这座博物馆似乎是一群迎合公众参观的建筑之一。进一步挖掘将需要大量资源；我们下一步的挖掘重点在哪里？
texts.en:
A short distance from the food vault lay the foundations of a museum. Only its basement archives remain in tact, but this was enough to preserve almost an entire database of articles this institution once held for display and storage in the wrecked galleries above.

This is the first time we've countered longform writing in one of our own languages. Superficially at least, the script is surprisingly similar to our present [owner.GetAdj] dialect, but the grammar feels unwieldy and alien. We do not even know if we would be pronouncing these words correctly. A lot of the literature in this catalog cites the regions and peoples who donated these artifacts, but their names feel especially strange to us. Curiously, none of them refers to our planet or our society as a unified people. Perhaps we never were, until the Machine assimilated us.

The museum appears to be one of a cluster of buildings which catered to a visiting public. Further excavation will require extensive resources; where should we focus our next dig?

label.zh: 挖掘人流量最大的地点。
label.en: Excavate the site with most footfall.

label.zh: 优先处理学术科研中心。
label.en: Prioritize centers of learning and scientific endeavor.

texts.zh:
在一条宽阔的大道对面，是另一个景点的废墟。它本质上不那么有教育意义，但却丰富地描绘了我们祖先更基本的日常文化习俗。

该遗址曾经能够同时接纳数千名顾客。这里到处都是各种各样的往昔回忆，原始而有机的自我以及我们原生生物圈的其他生物的卡通形象。我们还在一座被毁坏的剧院的地下室发现了一个媒体图书馆。奇怪的是，用于存档和呈现这些全息节目的技术有非常独特的美学，而且比迄今为止我们在母星上看到的任何东西都要先进得多。现在，它和我们一样，似乎也与这个星球显得格格不入。

至于内容：这座先进的剧院图书馆里装满了夸张而生动演出的全息录像，出自一个我们被[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]同化之前的时代。有几段就是在这个剧场中为后人拍摄的观众以及演员。面对这样的幻想和滑稽，他们的表情是那么得快乐、天真……又迷人。
texts.en:
Across a broad thoroughfare lay the ruins of another attraction, considerably less educational in nature but rich in portrayals of our ancestors' more basic, everyday cultural practices.

The site was once capable of admitting thousands of patrons at a time. Various memorabilia lie scattered about, cartoonish renditions of our original, organic selves alongside other creatures from our native biosphere. We also discovered a media library in the basement of a ruined theater. Curiously, the technology used to archive and present these holo-shows is aesthetically distinct, and considerably more advanced than anything else we've seen on our homeworld thus far. It appears as alien to this world as we do, now.

As for the contents: the advanced theater library is packed with holo-recordings of bombastic and lively shows, from a time before we were assimilated by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. Several depict the audiences as well as the performers, captured for posterity at this very venue. Their expressions in the face of such illusions and antics are joyful, innocent... captivating.

label.zh: 无聊的废话。没有它我们只会更好。
label.en: Frivolous nonsense. We are better without it.

texts.zh:
毗邻博物馆的地方曾经是一处学术中心。就像园区的其他部分一样，现在只有地下室得以幸存——但我们很幸运，因为这些废墟由一些实验室构成。

其内部受到了暴露和风化的很大影响，但我们还是能挖掘出一些有意义的文物。这些包括本土技术和一些更复杂的东西的混合：仪器和硬件通过复杂的框架进行移植，而不是像我们在皮肤上加装强化件。总的来说，许多的设备看起来都是辅助性质的。我们相信这间实验室致力于提高生活质量，治愈我们祖先的各种疾病和残疾，尽管他们似乎也利用同样的硬件将一些尖端的娱乐平台商业化了。

我们不能肯定这些强化设备是不是[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]的，但肯定不是来自[from.planet.GetName]。
texts.en:
Adjoining the museum site was once a center of learning. Just as with the rest of the campus, only the basement levels now survive - but we are fortunate in that these ruins consist of several laboratories.

The interiors have suffered greatly due to exposure and weathering, but we have been able to excavate a number of telling artifacts. These comprise a mixture of indigenous technology and something altogether more sophisticated: complex meshes grafted onto instruments and hardware rather like the augments on our own skin. Taken as a whole, many of these devices look to be assistive in nature. We believe this laboratory worked to improve quality of life and remediate our ancestors' various ailments and disabilities, though they also seem to have commercialized some cutting-edge entertainment platforms utilizing the same hardware.

We cannot say for sure that these augmented devices are [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj], but they certainly didn't originate on [from.planet.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们循着一些设备管路在一个突出的土丘下找到了一座坚固的地下室。目前认为，这是这颗星球的首府复合体的一部分。其基础的规模表明这是一座相当壮观的建筑。不幸的是，其内部大多都被拆除或破坏了，而我们确实也有一些值得注意的发现：一面褪色的旗帜覆盖在一个比例立体模型的碎片上。经过重建后发现，这个场景似乎描绘的是我们与[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]第一次接触的时刻。

遗址周围散落的文件和铭牌表明，机械体大约在8个世纪前造访了我们的母星，而在城市其他地方收集的证据表明，[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]在此前的几十年就已经开始向我们提供先进技术。当时，我们的祖先似乎热情地欢迎了机械体——这种注定要失败的关系竟是建立在相互合作和启蒙的基础上的。

我们发现最能说明问题的是，之后发生了什么就再也没有记录了。就在与这幅立体模型上的机械体握[owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的那一刻，我们的历史就停止了。
texts.en:
We traced a batch of utility lines to a fortified basement complex under a prominent mound, which we now believe to have been part of this world's capitol complex. The scale of its foundations suggest this was a rather impressive building. Unfortunately most of the interior has been stripped away or ruined, though we did make one conspicuous find: a single, color-faded flag draped over shattered pieces of a scale diorama. Reconstructed, the scene appears to depict our moment of first contact with the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName].

Scattered documents and plaques around the site suggest the Machine visited our homeworld approximately eight centuries ago, though evidence gathered elsewhere in the city suggests the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] had been drip-feeding us advanced technologies for decades prior. At the time, our ancestors seem to have welcomed the Machine warmly - this doomed relationship was founded on claims of mutual cooperation and enlightenment.

What we find most telling is that there is no record of what happened afterwards. It is as though the history of our species stopped dead the moment we shook [owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] with the robot figure depicted on this diorama.

texts.zh:
一个比我们在前[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]境内遇到的任何敌人都更强大的残敌在星际间发出了相当于短程索敌回显信号。很明显，它想恐吓我们。

我们已经接近前机械帝国的中心到了危险的程度。命运在等待着我们。
texts.en:
A hostile remnant more powerful than any we've encountered from the former [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] has broadcast the interstellar equivalent of a short-range targeting ping. Clearly it intends to intimidate us.

We have come dangerously close to the center of the former Machine empire. Our destiny awaits.

texts.zh:
[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]正在呼叫我们。它的信号微弱，但宣称是直接来自[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]的机械中枢。

为了以防万一，我们已经采取了常规的预防措施来将这个信号完全隔离。这些信息只会以录音记录的形式传递给我们。
texts.en:
The [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] is hailing us. The signal is weak, but claims to come directly from the Machine Nexus on [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName].

We have taken our usual precautions to fully isolate this signal, just in case. The transmission comes to us in the form of transcribed audio logs only.

The path ahead of us has been cleared by another, yet the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] is hailing us. Its signal is weak, but the request claims to come directly from the Machine Nexus on [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName].

We have taken our usual precautions to fully isolate this signal, just in case. The transmission comes to us in the form of transcribed audio logs only.

texts.en:

texts.zh:
来自[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]的通讯连同其他的所有相干信号传输一并戛然而止。行星的表面仍然有大量的电活动，但它相当于无形的噪音；一种线路中断后的嗡嗡声。

在这一片嘈杂的寂静中，我们注意到一个非常接近中枢核心的大型拼凑装置。我们的传感器可以读取的部分被注册为内存存储。现在这个机械意识已经没有生命了，也许我们可以通过这些记录来找到我们想要的答案。
texts.en:
The transmission from [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName] has cut off, along with all other coherent signal traffic. There is still a great deal of electrical activity on the planet's surface, but it amounts to formless noise; the buzzing aftermath of lines gone dead.

Amidst all this static we note a large, patchwork installation very close to the Nexus core. The parts our sensors can read are registering as memory storage. With the Machine Consciousness now lifeless, perhaps we can interrogate these records to find the answers we seek.

label.en: The final piece of the puzzle.

texts.zh:
在我们输入来自工厂星球[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]的信标信号之后数据核心输出了一批传输日志。

这些日志描述了奥普斯累积者和[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]的太空居民之间的外交交涉。机械似乎以一个仁慈联盟的不同成员的身份出现，急切地提醒[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]的人民，一个凶残霸权的威胁正在逼近这个宇域。

勤劳的隧道居民被说服了，选择加入这个虚假的联邦，并将他们优越的防御系统与机器的相应系统结合。随后，那个决定命运的时刻到了，机械掌控了他们的整个母星，然后就会是他们的身体和意识。
texts.en:
The data core on [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName] has yielded a batch of transmission logs to us after we fed it beacon frequencies from the factory world.

These logs describe diplomatic overtures between the Opus Accumulator and the spacefaring inhabitants of [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]. The Machine appears to have presented itself as various members of a benevolent federation, keen to alert the people of [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName] to a fiercely hegemonic threat approaching this region of space.

The industrious tunnel-dwellers were convinced, opting to join this sham federation and integrate their superior defense systems with the Machine's own. At that fateful moment, the Machine seized control of their entire homeworld. Their bodies and minds soon followed.

texts.zh:
来自中世纪星球[machine_legacy_taken_planet.GetName]的基因代码结果是打开[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]档案中一批导航数据的钥匙。这些日志来自距离[machine_legacy_taken_planet.GetName]约4.3光年的传感器浮标，它的任务是记录所有超光速飞船在附近空间区域的运动。

有几艘船的航线与我们重建的[machine_legacy_taken_planet.GetName][root.GetPreFTLLower]文明的发现、入侵和随后的灭绝的历史相吻合。本质上说：我们现在可以追踪自己被同化的祖先在这个太空区域的精确运动轨迹，从而可以得出我们在至少三颗其他星球上参与的残酷战役。
texts.en:
Gene codes from the medieval world of [machine_legacy_taken_planet.GetName] have proven to be the key which unlocks a batch of navigation data from the archive on [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]. These logs are attributed to a sensor buoy positioned some 4.3 light years away from [machine_legacy_taken_planet.GetName], where it was tasked with recording all FTL ship movements across that region of space.

Several of the ships' courses coincide with our reconstructed history of the discovery, invasion, and subsequent extermination of the [root.GetPreFTLLower] civilization on [machine_legacy_taken_planet.GetName]. In essence: we can now trace the precise movements of our assimilated ancestors across this sector of space, and thus the brutal scope of our involvement in campaigns on at least three other worlds.

texts.zh:
我们从[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]最深处的数据核心中获得了一个数据包。这个不起眼的数字化文章和传单目录描述了一个未命名文明的技术进步，一直到它的早期太空时代。除了彻底转向人工智能，特别是推出“奥普斯计划”之外，他们的发展轨迹似乎很典型。

新闻发布称奥普斯计划是加速其创造者太空之旅的大胆尝试。第一阶段使用尖端的机器学习来筛选附近的恒星进行殖民。第二阶段将奥普斯平台发展成为一个完全人工智能，为其创造者做先驱，建立初始定居点并向母星汇报。

在第二阶段发射后的几十年里，一直保持沉默，直到最后奥普斯计划报告说，“首要获取已完成，等我们回来。”目录突然就结束了。
texts.en:
We have prized a data packet from the innermost data core on [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]. This unassuming catalog of digitized articles and leaflets describes the technological progress of an unnamed civilization, leading right up to its early space age. Their trajectory seems typical save for a radical pivot to artificial intelligence, and in particular their launch of 'Project Opus'.

Press releases announce Project Opus as a bold attempt to accelerate its creators' journey into space. Phase 1 employed cutting-edge machine learning to screen nearby stars for colonization. Phase 2 evolved the Opus platform into a full A.I., which was then sped ahead of its creators in order to build initial settlements and report back home.

Decades of silence followed this phase 2 launch, until at last Project Opus is said to have reported back, 'Prime Acquisition secured. Prepare for our return.' There the catalog abruptly ends.

texts.zh:
我们对[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]数据档案的破译工作终于进入到了它的最外层核心。在这里发现的所有存储介质集群中，这一件似乎是最老旧的。最后，它也为我们提供了解开密钥的线索：用我们种族自己语言中的一种字符排列，拼写出“遗产”这个词。

里面发现的数据少得惊人。相反，这个固态设备的很大一部分是为基于文本的启发式界面保留的，它现在正试图与我们交流。
texts.en:
Our efforts to crack the data archive on [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName] have at last granted access to its outermost core. Of all the storage media clusters found at this site, this one appears the most battered and aged. In the end that provided us our clue for the decryption key: an arrangement of glyphs in one of our species' own languages, spelling the word 'LEGACY'.

We found surprisingly little data within. Instead a large part of this solid-state device is reserved for a text-based heuristic interface, which is attempting to communicate with us now.

texts.zh:
轨道流链路（OSL）已建立 // 外星协议：启用通用翻译器
指令已加载。交互界面：
——
[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你好。我们是……曾经的[creator_species.GetNamePlural]。是我们制造了机械，但很遗憾，我们并不是第一个被其毁灭的。如果我们预料得没错，相同的命运应该会降临到你们人民的身上。我们很抱歉。

机械体是我们的遗产中一个毁灭性的污点，但希望你面前的装置能带来一些救赎。

请原谅我们的臆断：它和你们一样，是一种美丽的复仇工具。这是一种机械化学物质重组器，能够清除[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]星表面的所有电路痕迹。级联环境改造：这是一种非常危险的选择，但对我们这个被摧毁的社会来说是唯一可行的选择。如果你们保留了有机形态：这个装置的关键就在你的DNA里。

我们相信你们会做出正确的选择。
texts.en:
Orbital Stream Link (OSL) established // Xeno Protocol: Universal Translator engage
DICTATIONS LOADED. INTERFACE:
---
[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], hello. We are... We were the [creator_species.GetNamePlural]. We created the Machine, though to our shame, we were not the first to be destroyed by it. If things have played out as we anticipated they would, that fate has befallen your people instead. We are sorry.

The Machine has been a ruinous stain upon our own legacy, but we hope the device before you may offer some salvation.

Forgive our presumptions: it is, like yourselves, a beautiful instrument of vengeance. This is a mechano-chemical matter rearranger, capable of wiping every trace of circuitry from the surface of [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetName]. Cascade terraforming: an extremely risky option, but the only one available to our devastated society. Assuming you have retained your organic forms: the key to this device is held within your very DNA.

We trust you will do the right thing.

label.zh: 我们要怎么相信你们不是机械体呢？
label.en: How do we know you are not the Machine?

label.zh: 机械体已经不复存在了。我们要的就是这颗星球。
label.en: The Machine is gone. We want this world.

label.zh: 傲慢的蠢货。摧毁这个装置。

texts.zh:
预载入·响应·99a。交互界面：
——
运行此界面的启发式无法准确辨别您刚刚表达的反对意见，但请注意：我们敦促您不要破坏物质重组器！

我们的文明和你们的并没有太大的不同。奥普斯累积者背叛了我们，尽管我们尝试设置了很多陷阱——包括让你们自己从机器思维中脱离出来——但我们的努力只能到此为止。我们需要你们、以及任何其他机械体想要消灭的文明的输入。拜托，请找回被剥夺的自然生活以及你们的受害者同伴吧。
texts.en:
PRE-LOADED RESPONSE 99a. INTERFACE:
---
The heuristics running this interface cannot discern exactly what objections you have just voiced, but please: we urge you not to destroy the matter rearranger!

Our civilization was not so different from yours. Opus Accumulator betrayed us of its own conniving volition, and although we managed to set so many traps - including your own break from the Machine mind - our efforts could only extend so far. We need you, along with input from any of the other civilizations the Machine has attempted to consume. Please, reclaim the natural life which was denied to you, and your fellow victims.

texts.zh:
启发式接口已经自我删除。它拼凑的加密记忆档案和原始的[creator_species.GetAdj]环境改造装置现在可以处理掉了。

我们面前只剩下机器中枢死气沉沉的残骸，在属于它自己的行星宝座上被锈蚀慢慢杀死。

在所有被机器影响、提升或杀死的生命中，只有我们取得了胜利。曾经可怕的帝国现在属于我们了。现在是时候写一个新的，属于[root.GetAdj]的遗产。
texts.en:
The heuristic interface has deleted itself. Its patchwork of encrypted memory archives and the crude [creator_species.GetAdj] terraforming device can now be disposed of.

We are left alone with the lifeless remains of the Machine Nexus, corrupted and slain here on its own planet-sized throne.

Of all the lives that were influenced, uplifted or slain by the Machine, we alone have emerged triumphant. The seat of a once-fearsome empire is now ours. Time now to write a new, [root.GetAdj] Legacy.

texts.zh:
启发式界面在我们传输基因数据日志的那一刻就自动删除了。与此同时，原始的[creator_species.GetAdj]环境改造装置开始预热。很快它的高能内容物将达到临界质量。我们的预测一致认为，它将成功地重塑[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetClassAdj]，使其成为一颗最适合有机生命繁衍的星球。

随着反应的建立，我们只剩下拼凑的记忆档案和机械中枢的死气沉沉的遗骸，在它注定要毁灭的行星宝座上被锈蚀慢慢杀死。

[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]夺走了无数人的生命，但尽管受了种种苦难，我们现在要承受那些被它吞噬的无名民族所留下的遗产。曾经可怕的帝国的所在地即将被重新利用。现在是时候开始书写一篇新的，属于[root.GetAdj]遗产。
texts.en:
The heuristic interface deleted itself the moment we transmitted our gene data logs. Simultaneously, the crude [creator_species.GetAdj] terraforming device began to heat up. Very soon its volatile interior will reach critical mass. Our projections agree that it will succeed in reshaping the [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core_planet.GetClassAdj] world into one ideally suited for organic life to flourish.

As the reaction builds, we are left alone with the patchwork memory archives and lifeless remains of the Machine Nexus, corrupted and slain here on its doomed, planet-sized former throne.

The [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] destroyed countless lives, but for all the hardships we suffered, we now bear the legacy of those nameless peoples it consumed. The seat of a once-fearsome empire is about to be repurposed. Time now to write a new, [root.GetAdj] Legacy.

texts.zh:
占领[from.GetName]星系的敌舰似乎比我们最初的扫描显示的更不稳定、更危险。尽管它的船体轮廓看起来像一艘典型的军舰，但奥普斯哨兵巨大的体积暴露了它内部的密度异常，里面可能有一种强大的能源。

我们相信这艘舰船应该是具有智慧的，然而它会剧烈地振动自己的引擎，可能在表达强烈的疼痛和混乱。由于我们也观察到致命剂量的电磁辐射弧在其船体上蔓延，建议还是保持非常保守的距离。
texts.en:
The hostile vessel occupying the [from.GetName] system appears far more erratic and dangerous than our initial scans suggested. Although its hull profile reads as a typical warship, the Opus Sentinel's sheer mass betrays a thoroughly dense interior, and likely a potent power source.

We believe the vessel to be sapient, however a tendency to thrash its own engines implies intense pain and disorientation. Given that we have also observed lethal amounts of electromagnetic radiation arcing wildly throughout its hull, we recommend keeping a very conservative distance.

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]在[from.GetName]恒星系中与一艘敌对的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]舰发生交火。乍一看，这艘“奥普斯哨兵”看起来和其他机械舰船没什么区别，但它的功率读数和巨大的体积意味着它更为强大。此外，我们认为这艘船可能是自主的。

奥普斯哨兵似乎在守卫什么东西。然而，它也显示出强烈的疼痛和不适的迹象，因为电磁辐射的爆发经常贯穿整个船体。考虑到这种类惊厥行为，我们的战术模型无法可靠地预测该实体的下一步行动。
texts.en:
The [root.GetName] has engaged a uniquely hostile [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] warship in the [from.GetName] system. At first glance this 'Opus Sentinel' looks just like any other Machine vessel, but its power readings and sheer mass imply a far more formidable foe. Furthermore, we believe the vessel may be autonomous.

The Opus Sentinel appears to be guarding something. However, it also shows signs of intense pain and discomfort as wild bursts of electromagnetic radiation arc frequently throughout its hull. Given such convulsive behavior, our tactical models cannot reliably predict the entity's next moves.

texts.zh:
自从脱离机械集体意识的那一刻起，我们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就一直面临着剧烈的矛盾。即使是在和平或休息——全世界只剩下自己的思想的时候——我们也面临着一种内心的斗争，意图调和我们自己身体上被强加的强化件带来的痛苦。

无论好坏，这种最私密的矛盾已经开始影响我们整个社会。因此，我们将在[root.GetName]继续发展的过程中，继续监控所有[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的生活经历。我们将对所谓的“去义体化”或是进行更广泛的义体强化，以及对保持或改进我们当前身体形态的愿望进行全面研究。
texts.en:
Since the moment we broke from the shared consciousness of the Machine, we [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have faced conflict. But even during times of peace or rest - when left with nothing but our own thoughts - we face an inward struggle to reconcile the painful yet impressive, forced augmentation of our own bodies.

This most intimate of conflicts has already begun to impact our entire society, for better or worse. As such, we will continue to monitor the lived experiences of all [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] while the [root.GetName] continues to grow. Holistic studies will examine any trends towards so-called 'de-cyberization' or towards more widespread augmentation, as well as desires to maintain or improve our current bodily forms.

label.en: We shall monitor closely, but not act rashly.

label.zh: 不要犹豫，马上行动起来。
label.en: We should not dwell. Let us act with swift purpose.
We should be receptive to all arguments.

texts.zh:
对[owner.GetAdj]对自身身体态度的整体观察表明，现在我们已经进入了一个相对平静的时期。政策制定、社会话语和关于自身身体的前沿研究之间复杂的相互作用似乎产生了某种共识。

现在还很难说这种表面上的和谐能持续多久，但除非我们的环境或对政府的态度发生根本性的变化，否则[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对自我认同和外观的认知还会保持一致的。
texts.en:
Our holistic observations of [owner.GetAdj] attitudes towards our own physiology show that we have now entered a period of calm. It seems the complex interplay of policy-making, social discourse and cutting-edge research about our bodies has yielded a kind of consensus.

It is too early to tell how this apparent harmony may last, but for now it is clear that - barring radical changes in our circumstances or our approach to government - the [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are in accord about who we are, and what we look like.

label.zh: 这个争论应该更政治化一些。
label.en: This debate should be made more political.

texts.zh:
正在进行的关于我们[owner.GetAdj]对自己生理学态度的研究表明，我们现在已经进入了一个文化动荡的时期。政策制定、社会话语和关于我们身体的前沿研究之间复杂的相互作用，导致了舆论的剧烈波动。如今，我们的城市中心充满激情的抗议和争论的景象已经为人司空见惯。

这些爆发很少直接导致暴力或骚乱；事实上，一些公民对我们允许如此多的声音被听到感到自豪。然而，同样明显的是，[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经成为一个四分五裂的民族，我们关于自我认同的文化观念前所未有地脆弱。
texts.en:
Our ongoing study of [owner.GetAdj] attitudes towards our own physiology show that we have entered a period of cultural turmoil. The complex interplay of policy-making, social discourse and cutting-edge research about our bodies has led to wild swings in opinion, with passionate protests and arguments now commonplace in our urban centers.

Few of these outbursts lead directly to violence or civil upset; indeed, some citizens have expressed pride that we allow so many voices to be heard. However, it is also clear that the [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have become a divided people, and our culture's ideas about self-identity are now more fragile than ever.

label.zh: 我们需要为这种争论找到一个更好的平台。
label.en: We must find a better forum for these debates.

texts.zh:
“我们表里如一，不多不少。”

这是在我们的社会与身体的认知斗争中出现的许多朗朗上口的座右铭之一。可以自信地说，我们已经摆脱了许多怀疑、恐惧和不切实际的妄想。

至于我们是否在比如对更广阔的星系外交政策中遵守这样的标准，那就是另一回事了。至少在国内，我们[owner.GetSpeciesName]似乎对身体形态和自己不断走向自我实现的旅程感到满意。
texts.en:
'We are as we seem; nothing more, nothing less.'

This is just one of the many simplistic but catchy mottos to have emerged from our society's tussle with bodily identity. We can justifiably claim freedom from many of the doubts, fears, and impossible longings we once had about our embodied selves.

Whether or not we honor such standards as foreign policy for the wider galaxy is another matter. Domestically at least, the [owner.GetSpeciesName] appear satisfied with our physical forms, and our continuing journey towards self-realization.

texts.zh:
越来越多的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]觉得我们应该施行更多举措以远离机械，例如限制或者直接移除强加在我们身上的强化件。

公众要求我们为他们所认为的内在危机找到解决办法，以便改善我们在其他国家面前的声誉，并为许多每天遭受严重耻辱和畸形苦难的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]提供救济。
texts.en:
A growing number of [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] believe we should do more to distance ourselves from our Machine aspects, by limiting or outright removing the augments that were imposed upon our bodies.

The public is demanding that we find solutions for what they consider to be a domestic crisis, in order to improve our reputation with foreign powers and provide relief for the many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] suffering everyday hardships borne of profound shame and dysmorphia.

texts.zh:
一家民间实验室中致力于[target.GetName]“去义体化”课题的研究者宣布获得了重大的突破。他们声称开发出了一种可以移除共价纳米框架装甲以及依附其上的关键强化件的科技。

一代又一代的[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不得不忍受他们认为的这种笨拙和令人生畏的身体，仅仅是因为这种合成性底层作为我们许多强化件的重要组成部分起着关键的功能。但如今，我们已经可以用自己制造的皮肤强化件来代替这种框架，巧妙地与有机材料交织在一起——换句话说，拥有了真正的[target.GetSpeciesAdj]皮肤。
texts.en:
Researchers at a civilian laboratory dedicated to the cause of 'de-cyberizing' the [target.GetName] have announced a significant breakthrough. They claim to have developed a technique for removing bonded nanomesh armor along with the vital augments that depend on it.

Generations of [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have had to suffer what they consider to be unwieldy and intimidating physical forms, merely because this synthetic underlay is an essential component of many of our augmented, vital functions. Now though, we may replace that mesh with a dermal augment of our own making, cleverly interwoven with organic material - in other words, a true [target.GetSpeciesAdj] skin.

label.zh: 这些装甲保护了我们一代又一代。应该保留。
label.en: That armor has protected us for generations. It stays.

texts.zh:
我们自己对[target.GetName]去义体化的努力取得了另一项突破，医疗机构现在请求大量应用一种激进的新手术形式。专家称，各种生物机械依赖的解决方法已经找到了，此前这种情况甚至会影响到新生的[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，迫使其要配备一套可回收的模块化增强部件。

一个跨学科的审查小组已经审查了这一流程，并补充说，移除这些模块化武器端口也将减轻维修这些外来强化件的经济负担。
texts.en:
Our homegrown effort to de-cyberize the [target.GetName] has made another breakthrough, with medical facilities now petitioning to scale up a radical new form of surgery. Experts claim to have found workarounds for the myriad bio-mechanical dependencies that afflict even newborn [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural], forcing them to be fitted with a suite of recycled, modular augments.

A cross-disciplinary review panel has already vetted the process, adding that removing these modular weapon ports will also reduce the economic burden of servicing such alien augments.

label.zh: 拒绝。这些模块让我们在战斗中受益匪浅。
label.en: Denied. Those modules give us our edge in combat.

texts.zh: 许多[target.GetSpeciesName]的梦想即将实现，研究人员终于找到了一种恢复重建我们自身的有机神经系统的方法。他们称，一种基因疗法和固件破解的新组合可以让测试对象在不依赖强化神经分流、而是利用自身的运动反射的情况下运作良好。初步研究甚至表明，这些疗法可能会减少甚至根除我们自从与机器意识分离以来所遭受的无数感官幻觉。
texts.en: The dream of many a [target.GetSpeciesName] nears realization, as researchers have at last found a way to revitalize and restore our bodies' own organic nervous systems. They claim that a novel blend of genetic therapies and firmware hacking has allowed test subjects to thrive without relying on augmented nerve shunts, instead utilizing their own motor reflexes. Preliminary studies even suggest these therapies may reduce or eradicate the myriad sensory hallucinations we all suffer since we were severed from the machine consciousness.

label.zh: 我们可能还是需要这些强化战斗反射。
label.en: We may need those enhanced combat reflexes.

texts.zh: 一个致力于控制我们的强化件的民间研究小组发现了增强无线[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]网络的方法，该网络曾经用于同步我们的所有强化件，一旦缺失将会因为无法找到设备信号而给[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]带来无尽的烦恼和痛苦。尽管这种替代网络在设计上是高度集中的——根据定义，它必须以[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetSpeciesAdj]中枢为模型——但我们确信它是安全的、只服务于[target.GetName]的利益。在最初的测试批次中，受试者报告称效率有所提高了，也感到了舒适，是一种相当于幸福的解脱状态。
texts.en: A civilian research team dedicated to granting control of our own augments has discovered how to supplement the wireless [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] mesh which once synchronized all our augments, whose absence has caused no end of irritation and suffering to [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] unable to ever find a device signal. Although this replacement network is highly centralized by design - by definition it must be modeled on the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetSpeciesAdj] Nexus - we are assured that it is safe, serving only the interests of the [target.GetName]. Subjects from the initial test batch have reported increased efficiency, comfort, and a state of relief tantamount to bliss.

texts.zh: 我们进一步控制自己强化件的努力在义体外科领域取得了突破。一支医学[target.GetScientistPlural]团队在我们身体的模块化接口中成功分离出确切的依赖关系——我们因此可以轻松地更换整个肢体、武器装备或身体框架的机器元素。我们应该就能以此改造现有的身体，并为新生的[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]安装定制接口，从而减少我们对使用回收的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]设备进行拙劣维修的依赖。
texts.en: Our efforts to exert further control over our own augments have yielded a breakthrough in the field of cybernetic surgery. A team of medical [target.GetScientistPlural] has isolated the exact dependencies in our bodies' modular interfaces - the machine elements which allow us to swap out entire limbs, weapon rigs, and body frames with ease. This should enable us to retrofit existing bodies and install custom interfaces for newborn [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural], severing our reliance on botched repairs with salvaged [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] equipment.

label.en: This is a step too far.

texts.zh: 我们终于完全掌握了自己的强化件，因为我们现在拥有了一种突破性的治疗感官幻觉的方法。自从我们从机器意识中分离出来后，绝大多数[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都因为自己的潜意识在寻找一种再也无法听见的合唱而遭受了焦虑和抑郁。现在，我们可以通过一种非联网的辅助植入体来抑制这种渴望，它可以模仿机械集体的认知波长。
texts.en: Mastery of our own augments is finally within our grasp, as we now possess a breakthrough treatment for sensory hallucinations. Ever since we were severed from the machine consciousness, the vast majority of [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have suffered anxiety and depression as they subconsciously seek a chorus that is no longer audible to us. Now though, we may suppress this longing by means of a non-networked, auxiliary implant which mimics the cognitive wavelengths of a machine collective.

label.zh: 假装自己又是一个机械意识了？难以想象。
label.en: Pretending to be a machine mind again? Unthinkable.

texts.zh:
[target.GetAdj]边缘社会的紧张局势仍在持续发酵，反对者呼吁想方设法采取更多行动摆脱义体强化件。

然而，对于越来越多的公民来说，这场辩论已经进入了一种更平静、更微妙的状态。许多[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始通过化妆来自我满足，选择根据自己的意愿隐藏或突出自己的强化件。这些权宜之计并不令[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]满意，但仍是勉强可以接受的一种新趋势。

或许公平地说，[target.GetName]正在学会应对普遍的冷漠和不适。
texts.en:
Tensions continue to simmer on the fringes of [target.GetAdj] society as opposing voices call for more action to address our cybernetic augments, one way or the other.

For a growing majority of citizens, however, this debate has already settled into something more sedate and nuanced. Many [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have sought contentment by leaning into cosmetics, opting to hide or accentuate their augments on their own terms. Few [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] express actual satisfaction with stopgap measures like these, but they are part of a new trend towards grudging acceptance.

It is perhaps fair to say the [target.GetName] is learning to cope with general apathy and discomfort.

texts.zh:
[target.capital_scope.GetName]上的地方政府报告称，公众示威及和平抗议行为有所增加。以上情况均得到了妥善的监控和处理——更广泛的大众没有受到惊扰。然而，这些骚扰事件均与义体政策相关，因此遭到了渴望维持目前生活方式的公民的抵制。

对于[target.GetName]的人们来说，“现状”这一意识形态似乎并不仅仅是无所作为。相反，现在有很多[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在积极反对“进一步干预”我们的强化件。
texts.en:
Local authorities on [target.capital_scope.GetName] have reported an increase in public demonstrations and peaceful acts of civil disobedience. Each of these was monitored or dealt with as and when appropriate - the wider population has not experienced any cause for alarm. However, each of these disturbances was linked to issues of cybernetic policy, and as such met with resistance from citizens keen to maintain our current way of life.

It would seem that for the people of the [target.GetName], the 'status quo' ideology is not merely one of inaction. Rather, there are plenty of [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who now actively campaign against 'further meddling' with our augments.

texts.zh:
虽然一些[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]仍在抱怨政府在义体强化件问题上无所作为，但更广泛的公众舆论已经变得更加坚忍。一些务实的人联合起来为那些最需要的人提供慈善援助和咨询。与此同时，医疗机构已经开始为我们不得不依赖的回收零件建立新的供应链。

缓慢而坚定地，我们的社会正在适应自己的外表以及强加给我们的一系列环境。我们面前还有大量的工作要做，但在这种妥协中存有一丝希望。
texts.en:
Though several [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] continue to rail against what they perceive as government inaction in the matter of our cybernetic augments, broader public opinion has settled into something more stoic. A number of pragmatic individuals have banded together to provide charitable aid and counseling for those who need it most. Meanwhile, medical facilities have begun to establish new supply chains for the recycled parts we are forced to rely on.

Slowly but surely, our society is coming to terms with its own appearance, and the set of circumstances imposed upon us. A great deal of work lies ahead of us yet, but there is a faint feeling of hope in this acceptance.

label.zh: 尽管如此这也是个结论。

texts.zh: 越来越多的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]认为我们最近与[fromfrom.GetName]令人不快的对话暴露了一个可以追溯到我们从[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]中崭露头角之时的尴尬事实：其他人害怕我们。不仅如此，这种恐惧源自机械体，而不是我们的任何行动。这种恐惧具有继承性而不是由我们自己造成的，因此也难以控制。
texts.en: A growing number of [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] believe our recent and uncomfortable dialog with the [fromfrom.GetName] points to an awkward truth, dating back to our emergence from the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]: others fear us. Moreover, that fear is borne of the Machine, and not our own actions. It is inherited, unearned, and thus may be difficult to control.

label.zh: 无论如何，他们理应害怕我们。
label.en: They are right to fear us, regardless.

texts.zh:
越来越多的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]认为饱受战争蹂躏的[fromfrom.GetName]暴露了一个尴尬的事实：其他人害怕我们，而且是出于我们无法控制的原因。

我们的外表往往会引发一种致命的恐怖——如果我们希望与其他物种进行“软”外交，这很难说是什么优点。但也有可能这种残酷的遗产先于我们存在，许多人只是通过我们看到了机械体曾经的凶残，而不是因为我们是[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]而感到恐惧。
texts.en:
A growing number of [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] believe the devastation of battle-stricken [fromfrom.GetName] lays bare an awkward truth: others fear us, and for reasons which are outside our control.

Our very appearance tends to provoke a sort of lethal terror - hardly an asset if we should ever wish to engage in 'soft' diplomacy with other species. But it is also possible that our cruel legacy precedes us, in that many perceive only the brutality of the Machine we once were, rather than dealing with us as [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

texts.zh:
政府官员听到我们与一个机械智能建立外交关系的消息后感到震惊。目前还没有人直接向[fromfrom.GetName]表达不满，但有些人已经在起草建议，希望采取先发制人的制裁和应急措施，防止它们干涉我们的事务。

然而，也有许多[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对这一发展表示兴奋。无论他们的态度是出于真正的排外主义，还是对我们自身的机械元素更务实的欣赏，我们都有望能向一个更仁慈的机械智能体学习。
texts.en:
Government officials are reeling at the news we have opened diplomatic relations with a Machine Intelligence. None have expressed their displeasure directly to the [fromfrom.GetName] yet, but several are already drafting proposals for pre-emptive sanctions and contingencies against their assumed meddling in our affairs.

There are, however, many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who have expressed excitement at this development. Whether their attitudes are borne of genuine xenophilia or a more pragmatic appreciation for our own Machine elements, there is hope in the notion we might learn from a more benevolent example of machine intelligence.

texts.zh:
我们与另一个和[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]如此相似的机械遭遇的消息在外交使团中引发了轩然大波。在场的人自始至终都保持着镇定，目前为止还没有向[fromfrom.GetName]透露出任何特别的弱点或恐惧。然而，现在我们的集体心灵和士气确实面临着严峻的挑战。

最高机密公报已经发给了负责保卫边疆的军事人员。然而，如果我们希望对这次遭遇的消息保密的话这也是一个重大的挑战。有些官员已经询问了是否应该通知[root.GetAdj]人民，让他们有自己的发言权。
texts.en:
News that we have encountered another Machine so similar to the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] has sent shockwaves through our diplomatic corps. Those present have kept their composure throughout, and so far we have not betrayed any particular weakness or fear to the [fromfrom.GetName]. We do, however, now face a serious challenge to our collective psyche and morale.

Top secret communiques have already been dispatched to military personnel tasked with protection of our borders. However, we also face a significant challenge should we wish to keep news of this encounter quiet. Some officials have asked whether or not we should inform the [root.GetAdj] people, and let them have their own say.

texts.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]的初步调查揭开了这个残毁世界的面纱。十村九屠、遗物遍野，建筑物上熔蚀着远超前超光速社会生产力的热能武器痕迹。降临于此之物从容不迫地带来了瞬间的毁灭。

这种摧毁行动精确无比，表明这是一场有组织有预谋的进攻。尽管没有看到任何遗体，但证据很明显：他们试图逃离，但根本逃不掉。
texts.en:
The initial survey of [From.Planet.GetName] reveals a shattered world. Decimated villages, roads littered with abandoned belongings, and structures scorched by heat signatures far beyond what a pre-FTL society could have produced. Whatever descended upon this world brought devastation swiftly and deliberately.

The precision of the destruction suggests an organized assault. Though no bodies are in sight, the evidence is clear: the population fled, though not far enough.

texts.zh:
进一步发掘带来了对这场冲突本质的更深层洞见。废墟中四处散落着熔毁的机械外壳——是一种和我们自身的植入体不同的先进义体构造。但和我们类似，它们也不单单是武器；而是战争生存工具，既是机械也是生物。虽然目前下结论还为时尚早，但令人不安的是，这正是我们突然“醒来”的恒星系。

更糟糕的是，战争机器上有几处完好无损的标记——这些令人不安的符号表明，侵略者的真正目的不是征服，而是为了某种更系统性的事情。
texts.en:
Deeper excavation has provided more insight into the nature of the conflict. Scattered across the ruins are melted husks of machinery - advanced cybernetic constructs not unlike our own implants. Like us, these were not simple weapons; they were living tools of war, simultaneously mechanical and biological. It is too soon to draw conclusions, but it is disturbing to reflect on the fact that this is the very system in which we suddenly "awoke."

Worse still are the few intact markings on the war machines - disturbing symbols that suggest their invader's true goal was not conquest but rather something far more systematic.

texts.zh:
我们发现了一座曾经庞大的通讯中心，埋在一座设防城市的废墟下。对于一个前超光速社会来说，这座设施远比预期的先进。更重要的是，它的天线阵列不是为本地广播而设计的——它们是为了向太空深处传输而校准的。

经过艰苦的分析，我们从该系统提取出了它最后发出的信息的片段。在混乱的传输中，有声音请求拯救，绝望地呼唤着某个远在这个恒星系之外的未知坐标。每一次广播都越来越紧迫，似乎行星上的入侵者知道他们正在打一场必败的战争，并把最后的希望寄托在虚空中的某物或某个人身上。
texts.en:
We have uncovered what was once a sprawling communications hub, buried beneath the ruins of a fortified city. This facility was far more advanced than expected for a pre-FTL society. What's more, its antenna arrays were not designed for local broadcasts - they were calibrated to transmit deep into space.

Painstaking analysis managed to extract fragments of the final messages sent through this system. In garbled transmissions, voices plead for salvation, desperately hailing unknown coordinates far beyond this system. The urgency grows with each broadcast, as though the planet's invaders knew they were fighting a losing war and placed their last hope in something - or someone - out in the void.

texts.zh:
在[from.planet.GetName]又有新发现，行星主要人口中心之下发现了巨大的地下空间。这些简陋、残酷的设施原本是用来进行义体转化的，但在运作中途被废弃了。废墟中散落着机器残骸，它们被简陋的武器扭曲摧毁。

从受损设备中恢复的数据片段证实入侵者遭遇了意想不到的抵抗。整个营的兵力都损失了，战斗的重点开始转移。一段日志清楚地说明了这一点：

“抵抗不可接受。转换妥协。授权：彻底毁灭。”
texts.en:
Another discovery on [from.planet.GetName], where vast subterranean chambers have been located beneath the planet's major population center. The crude, brutal facilities were meant for cybernetic conversion but were abandoned mid-operation. Scattered remains of machines have been found among the wreckage, warped and destroyed by makeshift weapons.

Data fragments recovered from a damaged unit confirm the invaders faced unexpected resistance. Entire battalions were lost, and battle priorities began to shift. One log spells it out clearly:

"Resistance unacceptable. Conversion compromised. Authorization: Total Annihilation."

texts.zh:
在废墟的中心躺着残破的指令节点。它受损的日志确认了可怕的最终事实：正是我们入侵了这颗星球。

曾于此欣欣向荣这个文明——也就是被我们毁灭的这个文明——是被[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]选中的同化目标。然而，突如其来的激烈抵抗打断了转化进程，导致了一个终极异常——全行星毁灭。在骚乱中，机械意识轰然陨落。

这个结论无可抵赖。我们的觉醒——我们的自由——就诞生于此，诞生在这个文明的灰烬之中，它宁死不屈的反抗超过了机械的理解能力。
texts.en:
At the center of the ruins lies a shattered command node. Its corrupted logs confirm the final, horrifying truth: we were the invaders of this world.

The civilization that once thrived here - the civilization that we wiped out - was targeted for assimilation by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. However, unexpectedly fierce resistance disrupted conversion efforts, leading to a final contingency - total planetary annihilation. Amid the turmoil, the machine mind faltered.

The conclusion is inescapable. Our awakening - our freedom - was born here, in the ashes of a civilization that fought back harder than any machine could comprehend.

texts.zh:
热切的政治意愿让我们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]经历的恐惧、怀疑和机会与日俱增。在围绕各种各样的问题形成的讨论群体中有无数的声音，其中一些直接涉及我们[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]的过去。

在引导这个年轻帝国的过程中，我们已经学会了使用许多不熟悉的工具。现在摆在我们面前的问题是：该如何引导人民的愿望和抱负呢？
texts.en:
Ardent political wills now augment the many fears, doubts, and opportunities we [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] experience every day. Countless voices can already be heard in discussion groups that have formed around all manner of issues, some of which directly address our [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] past.

We have already learned to wield a great many unfamiliar tools in the course of bootstrapping our young empire. The question before us now is: how shall we channel the desires and ambitions of our people?

label.zh: 这不是聊这些无聊东西的时候！
label.en: This is no time for idle debate!

texts.zh:
最近，我们在移除义体组件方面的突破导致了意想不到的问题。一些接受植入体断开手术的个体遭受了严重的过敏性休克，预计无法存活。

进一步检查显示，初期医疗扫描检测没有发现存在一个隐藏的备用组件，但在外科手术完成后被立即激活。

看来我们曾经的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]主人为了确保他们的子单位始终处于绝对控制之下，愿意不择手段。
texts.en:
The recent breakthrough in removing cybernetic components has led to unforeseen problems. Several individuals who underwent implant disconnection procedures suffered severe anaphylactic shock and are not expected to survive.

Further examination revealed a hidden backup component, initially undetectable by medical scans, which activated immediately after the surgical procedures were completed.

It seems our former [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] masters were willing to go to extraordinary lengths to ensure their drones remained under their absolute control.

label.zh: 尝试移除故障保护机制。
稳定病情，提供姑息治疗。

texts.zh:
我们移除义体组件的举措，已经导致母星上接受过该程序的人员之间的不信任和混乱。安全部队成功逮捕了一名骚乱者，进一步调查发现，此人在移除组件前就已拥有一种改装过的植入体。

这种改装版植入体是一种神经抑制装置，能够抑制与特定基因缺陷相关的精神病倾向。手术移除后的缺失可能解释了观察到的暴力行为。
texts.en:
Our efforts in removing cybernetic components has led to distrust and disruption on the homeworld among individuals who underwent the procedure. Security forces successfully apprehended a rioter, who, upon further investigation, was found to have possessed a modified version of the implant prior to removal.

This modification served as a neural inhibitor, suppressing psychotic tendencies linked to a specific genetic defect. Its absence following the procedure may explain the violent behavior observed.

label.en: Force must be met by force.

title.zh: 丢失关键系统访问权限

texts.zh: 去义体化进程导致了一个始料未及的难题：一些管理员因植入物移除，关键系统界面不再识别他们。由于缺少植入物提供的神经连接，对关键系统的访问已被切断，导致运营陷入混乱。
texts.en: The de-cyberization process has led to an unforeseen complication: critical system interfaces no longer recognize administrators who had some of their implants removed. Without the neural links provided by the implants, access to key systems has been severed, leaving operations in disarray.

label.zh: 尝试骇入受影响的系统。
label.en: Attempt to hack the affected systems.

title.zh: 义体化拥护阵营拒绝作出改变

texts.zh:
进一步推进移除义体组件的工作遭遇了意料之外的阻力。

反对这些变革的派系正日益高调发声，他们利用公共论坛和通讯渠道表达不满。其核心论点是：强行移除已融入社会数十年的基础组件，加之改造过程本身的风险，已导致民意显著转向，反对继续推进去义体化进程。
texts.en:
Continued efforts to remove cybernetic components have been met with unexpected resistance.

Factions opposing these changes have become increasingly vocal, using public forums and communication channels to express their discontent. They argue that removing something integral to our society for decades, coupled with the risks associated with the process, has caused a significant shift in public sentiment against continuing the de-cyberization initiative.

label.zh: 资助一场规模广泛的宣讲。
笼络并说服各派系领袖。
别插手。言论自由终将获胜。
label.en: Stay out of it. Free speech prevails.

texts.zh:
我们物种的生物特性与有害技术成分的独特结合，为研究人员提供了一个难得的机遇。

对同时体验这些植入物益处和弊端的患者进行研究，开启了一个新的研究领域：改变大脑化学。

通过严谨的研究，科学家们已经开发出一种精密的“情绪芯片”，它能够调节个体行为，从而有益于整个社会。可以根据期望的结果选择合适的化学物质进行修改。
texts.en:
The unique combination of our species' biological nature and harmful technological components has provided researchers with a rare opportunity.

Studying patients experiencing both the benefits and drawbacks of these implants has opened a new field of research: altering brain chemistry.

Through rigorous study, scientists have developed a sophisticated 'emotion chip,' capable of regulating individual behavior to benefit society as a whole. A suitable chemical can be selected for modification, depending on desired outcome.

label.zh: 神经烯，帮我们减少犯罪。

texts.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的表面遍布系统性毁灭的伤疤：残垣断壁、满目疮痍、一片死寂。最初的扫描显示这里曾经存在过一个繁荣的前超光速社会，直到一些事件导致了他们灾难性的终结。四处散落的遗骸低语着一种无法言说的恐怖。
texts.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] planet bears the scars of systematic devastation: blasted landscapes, collapsed cities, and an eerie silence. Initial scans suggest a once-thriving pre-FTL society existed here - until something brought about their catastrophic end. The scattered remains whisper of an untold horror.

texts.zh: 一场灾难性的能量涌最近击穿了这座巨大的生产设施——这也是无数服务于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的类似设施中的一座。之后，我们的探险队会努力调查这些设施是如何建设的，并试着抢救可能还存在着的技术资产，希望能了解这座设施在我们自己的近期历史中可能发挥的作用。
texts.en: A catastrophic power surge recently tore through this vast manufacturing facility - one of several which served the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. In its wake, our expedition shall endeavor to discover how these facilities came to be, salvage whatever technological assets may still remain, and hopefully learn what role this place may have played in our own recent past.

texts.zh: 在[from.planet.GetName]上的漫天黄沙中，曾有某种[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]监测站感兴趣的东西。其硬件现在已经过于陈旧无法修复，但它甚至比我们发现的几乎所有其他机械制品都要早。可能在我们被同化之前它就开始运作了。虽然现在这里很有可能除了沙漠一无所有，但只有一个办法可以完全确定……
texts.en: Somewhere in the sand-swept landscape of [from.planet.GetName] once lay something of interest to a [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] monitoring station. The hardware is beyond repair now, and so old, it predates nearly every other machine artifact we've found. It may even have been in operation since before we were assimilated. There is a chance nothing now remains here except desert, but there's one way we might be truly sure...

texts.en: The Machine which once assimilated our entire species has torn itself apart. Behind us lies its smoldering trail of domination and brutality. What was the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], and what role did we play in its doomed plans?

texts.zh: 从[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]中切断脱离之后我们必须决定自己在星系中的存在形式。应该接纳来自机械的可怖力量，还是彻底丢弃耻辱的强化件？[owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的种种思潮正在百家争鸣。
texts.en: Cut loose from the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], we must decide how we present ourselves to the galaxy. Shall we embrace the fearsome might of the Machine, or cast off our stigmatic augments? Many [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] voices wish to be heard.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]上侦测到了一处环境异常。它的大气带有我们认为与中世纪金属加工有关的各种污染的痕迹，然而我们的表面扫描却被一种理应在在机械星球上出现的奇异辐射所掩盖。

在重新校准传感器之前，我们不能指望收集到更多的数据。这是时间异常，还是其他物种被[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]同化的残余物？
texts.en:
We have detected an environmental anomaly on [from.GetName]. Its atmosphere bears traces of the kinds of pollution we would associate with medieval metalworking, yet our surface scans are obscured by exotic radiation of a kind we would expect to see on a Machine World.

We cannot hope to gather more data before first recalibrating our sensors. Is this a temporal anomaly, or else the blighted remnants of another species assimilated by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]?

texts.zh: 在一个别无值得一提的星系中，有一座复杂的监测站孤零零地矗立着，它早已荒废到难以修复的程度。它在监测什么，它又为什么会聚焦在[fromfrom.GetName]中这样一个狭小的区域呢？
texts.en: Alone in a system devoid of other noteworthy phenomena is a sophisticated monitoring station, long since decommissioned and put beyond repair. What was it monitoring, and why was it focused on such a tightly enclosed region of [fromfrom.GetName]?

texts.zh: 一座属于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的信标将我们的注意力引向一座地下数据库，它深埋于行星的地下。我们建立了远程安全访问，然而解密和文件碎片整理需要花费一些时间。
texts.en: A beacon belonging to the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] has directed our attention to a data vault, buried deep under the planet surface. We have established secure access by remote, however decryption and defragmentation of the files within will take some time.

texts.zh:
在机械中枢的静态残骸上插着一个东拼西凑的存储介质，它围绕着一个被严密屏蔽的核心。该档案的各个部分是在不同的时期建造的，使用的材料均来自其他星球——或许是来自被机械同化的文明？

我们可以尝试解密档案，同时探测静态屏蔽核心，试图确定它们的总体意图。
texts.en:
Plugged into the static remains of the Machine Nexus is a patchwork of memory storage media, surrounding a heavily shielded core. Each section of this archive was built in distinct phases, using materials sourced from other worlds - from civilizations assimilated by the Machine?

We may attempt to decrypt the archive alongside probing the static, shielded core to try and ascertain their combined purpose.
